designationHistory.indexText: Cache River National Wildlife Refuge was established to protect bottomland hardwood wetlands for wintering waterfowl.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cache River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Environmental Assessment and Forest Habitat Management Plan Cache River and Bald Knob National Wildlife Refuges (ServCat 152673): "Cache River National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established on June 16, 1986"

review.note: June 16, 1986 (Cache River forest habitat management plan EA). Authority assumed MBCA (recent hunt plan cites the MBCA).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1986, this refuge was born out of a commitment to safeguard, restore, and enhance wetland ecosystems, making it a sanctuary for migratory birds and a haven for diverse fish and wildlife.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
